description: Code, intermediate results, figures and supporting tables for the manuscript 'A selectivity-based analytical strategy for identifying lineage-selective cancer dependencies from DepMap data'. The current analysis uses DepMap 26Q1, 1,192 cancer cell lines and 467,091 gene-lineage tests, yielding 94 prioritised pairs. Input datasets are public but are not included in this archive; download instructions and input-file checksums are in the README. Version 2.1.0 adds a focused validation of one candidate (SNAP23 in the bowel lineage): eight checks whose pass criteria were written down before they were run (prespecified_plan_snap23.md), producing Fig 13 and S11 Table.
